title: Implement bounded incomplete attribute and default values
api_or_output: Real compatible optional incomplete attribute/default callbacks, bounded symbolic values, owned provenance and loss-refusing getters/output/copy

acceptance.description: Implement the verified incomplete attribute/default contract in real Core, DTD and DOM paths: physical EntityDeclared WFC/VC origin/order/first-unread matrix, known normalization, exact symbolic lexical gaps, applicable/unused/overridden defaults and namespace participation/refusal. Deliver compatible optional callbacks with bounded borrowed lifetime and exact order/pause/cancel/count/quota behavior; preserve existing views, old sinks, 290-member API and content provenance. Never fabricate complete values or silently discard lexical identity. Node.cs ownership only GetAttribute direct slot-read guard; other existing shared shapes remain frozen.

Actual source/DOM/stream tests cover the exact seven authored input/resource identities (3 WFC controls and4 VC-only representations), origin/declaration-order/first-unread matrix, known literal/numeric normalization, direct/indirect/multiple adjacent gaps, later forbidden errors, unused/overridden defaults, incomplete namespace refusal, enumeration/getters/mutation/detachment, every short character/byte/entity split and mappings, callback pause/cancel/fault, old sinks, exact/one-over quotas. Actual serializer/BOM/Save and copy/text entry points prove no output or destination mutation before refusal. Preserve standalone/DTD repairs and original corpus applicability; no model-only runtime claims.

Compile independent frozen proposal/consumer and additive approved API fragment, preserve all prior public/internal shapes, prove real source/fresh package consumers. Run focused new and affected correctness plus planning/owned diff; preserve passing unchanged checks. Demonstrate zero warm borrowed allocation with positive owned controls and complete untimed oracles through reused verified measurement support; prepare/build outside one bounded exclusive sequence, require all children succeed, final identities and cleanup; timing informational. Keep concise summaries only and remove raw artifacts. Coordinator focused integration, comprehensive combined checks at M2 gate.

requests: Coordinator grants XmlDocument.UnresolvedReferences.cs only the existing RefuseUnresolvedReferences guard extension to also refuse either incomplete attribute/default provenance collection when nonempty. Preserve existing content message/behavior and frozen API/ABI; no unrelated edits. A1/A2 output/copy loss-refusal requires actual centralized guard. Worker acknowledged task-JSON-only hold.
